SELECT 
  ts_doy, 
  ts_season, 
  ts_hour,
  wtmp_c,
  ROUND((wtmp_c * 9/5) + 32, 1) as wtmp_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6 AND ts_doy >= 175 AND ts_doy <= 182
ORDER BY ts_t DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_boats,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 165 AND fish_date_doy <= 182
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC;

SELECT 
  index_id,
  value,
  avail_doy
FROM climate
WHERE avail_season = 6 AND index_id IN ('oni', 'pdo', 'npgo')
ORDER BY avail_t DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  report_date_doy,
  yt_local,
  yt_coronado,
  yt_north,
  yt_all,
  yt_local_catch,
  yt_coronado_catch,
  text
FROM fishdope
WHERE report_date_season = 6 AND report_date_doy >= 175 AND report_date_doy <= 182
ORDER BY report_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 10;
